eyebrow: Not RESTORE FROM URL — a BACPAC instead
code:
az sql db import \
  --resource-group myrg --server myserver --name mydb \
  --storage-uri "https://mystorage.blob.core.windows.net/backups/SalesDB.bacpac" \
  --storage-key-type StorageAccessKey --storage-key <key> \
  --admin-user sqladmin --admin-password <password>
